# API Collection Documentation

This collection contains endpoints meant for interacting with [Tanta Financial System API](https://github.com/AlMahllawi/tanta-financial-system-api).

---

## Starting

First of all, to be able to test the endpoints, authenticate (using `Users/Authenticate` endpoint) as `admin` with the default password: `admin1234`.

---

For detailed examples of requests and responses, please refer to the saved examples within each request in this collection.
